**Finding: compliant (preferred).**

The Agreement's only MFN mechanic is § 7.6, which benefits us — Vendor warrants Fees to Northwind will be no less favourable than fees offered to similarly situated customers for comparable volumes and terms. No Customer-side best-terms, right-to-match, or third-party-offer obligation exists anywhere (checked §§ 4, 7, 30 and full-text searches). Preferred position met; no redline proposed and the Vendor-granted MFN is left intact.
